title: Additivity of expectation for functions
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Then the expectation of their pointwise sum is the sum of their expectations: $\mathbb E_\pi(f+g)=\mathbb E_\pi f+\mathbb E_\pi g$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
